from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0169.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)

print('=== f169 full vertical profile: tone-change rows ===')
for u in [240,256,280,300,320,350,380,400,420,450,480,500,508]:
    prev=None; out=[]
    for v in range(60,512):
        t=(R[v,u]//14,G[v,u]//14,B[v,u]//14)
        if t!=prev: out.append('%d:(%d,%d,%d)'%(v,R[v,u],G[v,u],B[v,u])); prev=t
    print(' u%3d'%u, ' '.join(out[:14]))
" 2>/dev/null
